headline: Aliko Dangote Acquires 25% Stake in Kenya Pipeline Company
summary: Nigerian industrialist Aliko Dangote has purchased a 25% stake in the Kenya Pipeline Company, establishing a strategic footprint in East African energy distribution.
why: Cross-border infrastructure investments across Sub-Saharan Africa expand distribution routes for refined petroleum products.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Private capital injection supports infrastructure balance sheets and cross-regional energy logistics.
